messages.text: BL-1778 🎵 in progress — A driver seat's give-up (BL-1715) reverts only the attempt's own commits, the first-parent non-merge commits after its post-merge head, never the claim's merge of main or of the received commit and never a commit those merges brought in, so the seat's tree after a give-up is its post-merge tree and its next forward deletes nothing downstream
